en: Zhivan... You survived the Villa?
Like I said. Seen you around.
I was working here in Dazbog when I heard the shots. Saw fire and smoke breaking through Mist; could see it from afar. Don't need a genius to know my home is gone.
So I've been hiding here... But enough about me, I'm just a lucky old man. You survived too, huh? Well, we call you Returner for a reason.
They took everything from us, Brother.
Not the first nor the last time, Brother. It's always been this hard, which is why we're all on our own. Can't count on the townsfolk to protect us.
Some years I feel like every face I see is blurred. Not this time. I'll remember the folks who stood by'n did nothin' for us while we burned. They'll get theirs, God willing.
God? You're religious now?
Yes, I am. Haven't joined the Church or anything – but I've found God, now.
Go to mass when I can, help out here and there. 'Course, that might be hard to do now. Don't feel safe anymore.
Why are you interested in God?
I'm gettin' old, Returner. Time is like the Mist for us drifters. Saps away at the soul.
Religion gives us an escape from all the endless stalking. Would do you good to try it.
There are some who worship Mist, instead of this "God".
Instead of this "God".
Mudlarks, right? I have a fondness for 'em. Ilya and I are buddies, even. But they worship the Mist, and look how it deforms them. It must hurt.
However... They worship the Mist, and look how it deforms them. It must hurt.
I want to lessen my pain... Not heighten it. Through inner peace and all that. But maybe they're "right", and I'm "wrong"... Who really knows?
Are you looting these corpses?
Yes; mostly empty. Search them if you want, won't get in your way. We have but Tongue and Fangs.
We have but Tongue and Fangs.
The Mantras... We have but Tongue and Fangs.
Yes. The Mantras show wisdom.
Tongue and fangs...?
Now, brother; our routine may exhaust us and dull our senses, but do not forget the Carrion Mantras.
These small ties are what keeps Vultures going.
Let's talk of the Mantras.
Need a refresher?
About the Svarog Factories job...
Got questions?
I have to go now.
I've always repeated them without thinking, but...
And so you should. Carrion Mantras are the accumulated wisdom of us Vultures, condensed into a few short phrases.
We mutter them over and over during our repetitive routines for a reason. Keeps us sane. Reminds us of our values.
Do you know all of them?
Bah, no one knows all of them, Returner. There's no specific set, just a few more popular ones.
I won't recite them to you needlessly. You'll come across 'em again and again, as long as you keep working.
I've heard them before, but can't remember...
What with the recent violence, plus it looks like you've been hurt pretty bad recently? Yeah, you're in a bad spot, my brother. You'll make it through this cycle, God willing...
Let's talk of something else...
I need to get going.
I've made a decision about that favor.
What is it?
About your spot on the Zakrajev Line...
Ilya must have tipped you off, huh. Yes, I took on a high-profile gig recently. Been working up the courage to start it, but... Thinking of backing out, honestly.
Been gathering up the courage to start it... Why do you ask?
I could help.
Hmm. Tell you what; you do something for me, I'll let you take the job in my stead. "We come together in Scavenge", after all.
Tell you what; you do something for me, I'll let you take the job in my stead.
I've been working out of Dazbog for a while; decent spot, not too dangerous. But I need a hiding spot now – whoever destroyed our Villa could be hunting for survivors.
Somewhere close, like one o' those wagons along the train tracks, guarded from all sides... Find a spot like that for me, I'll reward you – and also let you take that bigger job. What do you say?
Find a spot like that for me, I'll reward you – and also let you take that bigger job in my stead. What do you say?
I'll find a place for you – near the train tracks.
Thank you. I'll make it worth your trouble.
Need to think about it.
Well, don't take too long, or I'll have to go on that bigger job alone.
Remind me what to look for.
I was hoping for a spot near the train tracks, surrounded by those old wagons. Somewhere where I won't be too open to attacks.
And o' course, you'll have to kill any Bandits or Mutants near it.
I'll get back to it.
Alright. Don't take too long.
Ah, yeah. Perfect for an atrophied bastard like m'self. I'll get going soon, Returner... Here's your reward.
And about that big job?
About that. A Mechanist at Sontse Station needs materials from the Svarog Factories... Used to be just Bandits in there, nothing too crazy; but then the Gunners moved in to fight over the turf...
I'll give up on the run so you can go in my place. Talk to a man named Anatoly; I don't think he'll doubt you if you mention my name and the details I've given.
Here... This is the Amulet I broke for him. Show it, and he will know I've passed the job to you.
I'll go talk to the Mechanist, then.
Good. To get to Sontse from here, you'd head South until a bit after crossing the tracks, then just go way East. Careful with those Bandits on the way.
Good luck, Returner.
Why did you give up on the job, really?
Not feeling so hot lately. That's why I'm sticking to Dazbog Hollow and its corpses for now. Plus, the attack on the Villa's got me rattled.
Factory's a mess right now, with the Gunners trying to muscle in on a Bandit hideaway. Bandits are disorganized and weak, but they got the numbers...
Also – Mist's been closing in on that place, from the East... A weird pattern, for sure. Can't claim to understand why.
Tell me more about this Anatoly.
He's not a kind man, but he has plenty of money. Would've been good to earn his clientele, but...
Look, most Mechanists wouldn't hurt a fly, it's true. They're geeks. But they do look down on us Vultures... Just keep that in mind.
No more questions.
Good.
Yes, let's trade.
We never Give without Taking.
Let's do the usual thing.
Always up for a good trade.
Until later, brother.
'Til next time, Returner.
Good luck on your work.
Bye for now; always a pleasure, brother.
Ah, the Returner! Glad you've survived, as well...
Hello, colleague.
Hello, brother-in-scavenge.
We come together in Scavenge.
Let's talk a bit.
Let's have a chat between Vultures.
Got some questions, Zhivan.
Wanna trade?
Anything you'd be willing to trade for?
Let me look at your wares.
You've been muttering about a big job...
Seems you're worried about a job you took?
Heard you know of a big job.
I've found and cleared a spot for you.
Down by the tracks – there's a spot.
Did what you asked.
I'll take them out.
Thank you. We have but Tongue and Fangs.
Bit dangerous – gonna think on it.
I understand. But remember... We see Death in comfort.
Got something else?
Thank you.
Try to be more careful.
I'll go take a look.
Good. Just be careful out there.
Need to think about it.
Ok, I'm not in a rush.
Hmm. Anything else you need?
We never Give without Taking.
Glad to help.
Any scavenges for me?
Any trouble I can help with?
Spotted some odd fellows chasin’ me around the other day. Why don’t you surprise them while their eyes are on me?
This area shouldn’t have so many Bandits around – they’re gettin' fearless. Help me deal.
Knew you could do it. Here you go.
Did they make you break a sweat? Here's my thanks.
As expected, you're in one piece. Here – your reward.
There’s a couple places Vultures haven’t scavenged yet. We need 'em clear of Mutants and Bandits before venturing in – you up for it?
Been a couple casualties in our group recently – all around the area I’ve marked on your map. Why don't you see what's up.
You took care of all that trouble? Great. Here's your reward.
Glad you're back. Couldn't have been easy. Here you go.
You've done us all a great service. Here. We never Give without Taking.
Today will be a day of typical scavenging for you, I'm afraid. Got no extra requests.
I have no more to ask of you, for now.
Don't have anything else right now. Try again later.
Until later, brother.
Good luck on your work.
Bye for now; always a pleasure, brother.
'Til next time, Returner.
Let's have a chat between Vultures.
Got some questions, Zhivan.
Let's talk a bit.
We never Give without Taking.
Let's do the usual thing.
Yes, let's trade.
Always up for a good trade.
Wanna trade?
Let me look at your wares.
Anything you'd be willing to trade for?
Tell me more about this favor.
I'm not interested.
Huh? I thought that's what you came here to ask about...
There are some things I'd like to find, so I can make sets and plan out some better trades. Would you help?
There's a few trinkets I had to pass on, but now I regret it. Would you find these sorts of things for me?
Thank you, Brother. This helps more than you think.
I'm glad you've got my back, Brother.
I've been searching for something... Not very valuable, just sentimental. Would you mind helping me out?
Some of the things I've scavenged throughout the years, I've decided to keep and not trade, for whatever reason. One of them is lost... Help me find it, please.
Ah, yes. This is it. It's hard to explain, but... I'm attached to this thing, see.
Thank you, Returner. I cannot really explain why this means what it means to me.
I'll find what you need.
Good, Brother. I expect news soon.
Need to think about it.
Yes, sometimes our own affairs take priority.
Got other jobs?
Never a bad thing to help a Brother-in-Scavenge.
Careful. You're losing your independence.
I guess I'll help.
I promise decent compensation.
Need time to think.
I understand; it doesn't sound like a pressing matter...
Got something else?
Wish I had something like that.
Get a grip, old man.
